name: Gradient Boosting Model
description: Generate forecast with Gradient Boosting Model.

componentProperties.preProcessTransformationsCode:
--[[ apply transformations to input data ]]
if args.dataSpecification.inTransformations then

    --[[ set max syserr to 4 (allow warnings) ]]
    local prevMaxSysErr = sas.get_max_syserr()
    sas.set_max_syserr(4)

    --[[ initialize references to the tables at the root ]]
    sas.symput('_timeseries', "&inData")
    sas.symput('_attributes', "&inAttributes")

    --[[ apply series of tranformations to input data ]]
    for i, transformation in ipairs(args.dataSpecification.inTransformations) do
        if transformation.type == 'FEDSQL' then
            --[[ submit query ]]--
            local query = transformation.value
            sas.submit[[
                proc cas;
                    fedsql.execDirect /
                        query="@query@";
                run;
                quit;
            ]]
        end

        --[[ update table reference so next transformation is applied to output of previous one ]]
        sas.symput(transformation.tableReferenceKey, transformation.tableReferenceValue)
    end

    --[[ restore max syserr ]]
    sas.set_max_syserr(prevMaxSysErr)
end
